descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The flood gates are open. The Nile rises. You have 45 minutes.  Pharaoh's Vault Escape is a multiplayer VR escape room set deep beneath the Pyramids of Giza. Gather your team, enter the tomb, and solve 7 ancient puzzles before the chamber floods. Play co-op in VR — or join from any device via WebXR cross-platform multiplayer.  
PUZZLES INCLUDE: • Scarab Compass — Identify which sacred beetles face East • Hieroglyphic Cipher — Decode a Rosetta Stone message to find the Eye of Horus • Scales of Ma'at — Balance hearts and feathers in Anubis's judgment ritual • Pyramid Builder's Math Tablet — Solve ancient calculations using Giza's real stone data • Orion Star Map — Navigate the Old Kingdom night sky to find the soul of Osiris • Canopic Jar Sequence — Arrange burial jars in the embalmer's sacred order • The Final Cartouche — Spell the word of eternal life to unlock the vault door  FEATURES: • Co-op multiplayer — VR headset + WebXR browser players in the same session • AI Mummy hint system — ask the Mummy if your team gets stuck • Rising water visual + audio pressure mechanic • Curriculum-aligned: History, Math, Science, Archaeology, Astronomy • Ambient Egyptian soundtrack, voice narration, and escalating sound design • 45-minute single-session experience — ideal for groups, schools, and team events  Prove yourself worthy to the Pharaoh. Escape the Vault.
